name: S.P. Apparels Ltd
title: S.P. Apparels Ltd - 540048 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 consolidated EBITDA fell to INR 44 cr (12.2% margin) on volume softness; management guides INR 2,000 cr FY27 revenue at 14-15% EBITDA, but utilisation is only 64% and capacity expansion is being deferred to FY28.

utilisation.quote: our utilization is only 64%. There is a good headwind for us to improve our utilization level in the current Indian factories.

capex.quote: We have just slowed down the project because of the US tariff uncertainty.

triggers.label: Salem and Sivakasi expansion deferred to FY28
triggers.quote: So, safely we are betting on FY28 for Salem expansion.

triggers.label: US orders return; pace to improve from Aug-26
triggers.quote: We are expecting the pace to improve from August ‘26.

triggers.label: FY27 INR 2,000 cr target vs ~INR 1,600 cr run-rate
triggers.quote: we are looking at INR 2000 crores next year. On a consolidated basis with a 14%-15% EBITDA.

guidance.quote: we are looking at INR 2000 crores next year. On a consolidated basis with a 14%-15% EBITDA.
On a consolidated basis with a 14%-15% EBITDA.
we are aiming for INR 200 to INR 250 crores during the next financial year out of Sri Lanka.
we should be anywhere between 12-14 million on the numbers for SPUK for the whole year FY27.
we are committed to reaching around 4.5 MW by March ‘27.
we are looking at with respect to 30% with US, 35% with Euro and 35% UK.

red_flags.label: Guidance vs capacity math gap
red_flags.quote: Where is the balance 150 going to come from?

red_flags.label: Retail finance cost; equity raise deferred
red_flags.quote: there is an elevated interest cost on Retail Venture which needs to be supported through equity.

red_flags.label: Contingent tariff reimbursement counted as upside
red_flags.quote: there is a strong probability that a portion of these discount credits will be reimbursed by customers

evasions.topic: Sri Lanka and Salem ramp-up math vs INR 2,000 cr
evasions.quote: That is why we are aiming for INR 2000 crores next year considering all these things.
Actually, it is not a labor disruption.
